description: Is this build already uploaded? Looks up the project's newest ready build by the file's sha256, else by a native fingerprint; build is null when neither matches. A sha256 match means the exact file is uploaded: run it with run_test {buildId} / run_project {buildIds} instead of uploading again. A fingerprint match (a hash of the native inputs the uploader stored with the build, for example @expo/fingerprint) means the native build is unchanged, so CI can skip building it. The command-line tool does this for files: testsy-ai build find / build ensure. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/

fingerprint.description: Native fingerprint stored with the build (8–128 characters)

sha256.description: sha256 of the build file, 64 hex characters

name: find_build
title: Find a build
